mpd_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Music Player Daemon server

mpd_port.description: TCP port number of the MPD server

mpd_password.description: Password for MPD authentication (empty if none required)

show_elapsed.description: Whether to show elapsed time in playlist view

sort_by_filename.description: Whether to sort playlist items by filename instead of title/artist metadata

cache_dir.description: Directory used to cache cover art images
